mappings.coverage: whole own-state level text producer with explicit fixedfilename formatter and I/O services
mappings.qualification: Prepared disjoint byte regions or exact in-place normalization; terminated input and adequate output/arena backing. Filenames fit native128-byte local, fixed%s.txt pattern only. Original archive/file transport, compressed reads and OS handle lifecycle are services, not recreated backends. Retried services must eventually return nonnegative read/seek. Advertised lengths0..0x10001; positive producer returns<=0x10000. Seek preserves original signed64-bitEDX:EAX return semantics. Negative read retries only; nonnegative short read still returns declared file length. Missing/oversize/error paths are bounded, not fixed to claim success. Normalization is byte-oriented and quote-unaware; single slash advances input even without a second slash. Return includes copied terminatingNUL, followed by anotherNUL. Authored complete files are byte-hash bound; oversized/empty files retain original rejection. No live level resource load or parser-record allocation is claimed. Managed replay remains pending; no generated executable retry.
